name: XBOX Nano Controller
description:
Our smallest controller, for big adventures. Portable. Pocketable. Effortless.

Put a little part of XBOX in your hands with an entry-level, rechargeable controller. Make it your go to for playing on the go.

Built for big adventures

Hop into Minecraft Dungeons II, Forza Horizon 6 and more (games sold separately). Explore games from across four generations of XBOX.

An easy way in

Great for smaller hands. Introduce someone to gaming. Gift it, share it, or play solo. Dive in, no big setup required.
shortDescription: Fit more play into your everyday. Great for smaller hands, so the whole family can play.

metaTags.title: Buy XBOX Nano Controller - See Price & Availability | Microsoft Store
metaTags.description: Shop the XBOX Nano Controller, a rechargeable, entry-level controller built for smaller hands so the whole family can play. Get the standard Xbox button layout in a portable, pocketable design.

values: Connect to Xbox consoles with Xbox Wireless. Wirelessly connect to Windows 10/11 PCs, tablets, iOS, Android, and compatible Smart TVs with Bluetooth. Wired connection supported via USB.
Internal, rechargeable battery. Requires USB-C cable for charging, sold separately. Up to 5hrs of battery life.
